style.backgroundSystem: alternating warm paper off-white #F5F2EA fields and deep slate blue #33455A display fields, no scenic depth except the depot scene
style.iconSystem: solid geometric square and rectangular label chips in #EE6A23 or #24303F, no ornamental line icons
style.lightingSystem: bright even studio light with a soft front key, controlled soft contact shadows, one warm accent rim in #EE6A23 for scene shots only
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent rugged team workwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm paper off-white #F5F2EA, deep slate blue #33455A, one safety-orange accent #EE6A23 and ink-navy text #24303F; bright even studio lighting with a soft front key and controlled soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; solid geometric label chips only; clean high-end apparel photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero garment angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no color palette changes beyond #F5F2EA, #33455A, #EE6A23 and #24303F
no mixed fonts and no serif or script lettering
no visible brand marks, staff name tags or store badges
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero garment angle, consistent garment scale, collar and chest pocket kept clearly readable
style.surfaceSystem: matte paper board #F5F2EA and matte deep-slate panel #33455A, garment laid flat or on an invisible form
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, bold headline plus small letter-spaced English eyebrow line
